verdict.rationale: Vapi can be driven without its dashboard. An official CLI manages assistants, phone numbers and calls from the terminal, a programmatic SDK is shown in the quickstart (`vapi.assistant`), and the Evals and Voice Test Suites frameworks run automated validation of agents before production. Together these cover the core of headless automation. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline integration docs (e.g. GitHub Actions or running evals in CI), documented non-interactive/API-key auth for headless runs, independent hands-on corroboration.
